facts: DBS and Kinexys launched 24/7 cross-border tokenized-deposit transfers between US and Singapore permissioned blockchain ecosystems.

institutional_events.interpretation: A parallel institutional payment rail. It is not an XRP or XRPL deployment.

facts: RLUSD became available through Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and Coinbase Retail.
